text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia
(Tarikh Peletakhakan) 2014.

Tarikh peletakhakan

2. Menteri menetapkan 1 Januari 2008  sebagai t arikh peletakhakan bagi maksud
seksyen 5 Akta dan pada tarikh itu segala harta, hak dan liabiliti—

(a) Kerajaan Malaysia;

(b) Ketua Pendaftar Koperasi bagi Malaysia  di bawah Akta Koperasi 1993
[Akta 502];

(c) Pendaftar Persatuan Nelayan di bawah Akta Persatua n Nelayan 1971
[Akta 44]; dan

(d) Pendaftar Pertubuhan Peladang di bawah Akta Pertubuhan Peladang
1973 [Akta 109],

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual hendaklah dipindahkan dan diletak  hak pad a
Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia tanpa apa -apa pemindahhakan, penyera hhakan atau
pemindahan hakmilik.

MALAYSIA CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES COMMISSION ACT 2007

MALAYSIA CO-OPERATIVE SOCIETIES COMMISSION (VESTING DATE) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 5(1)  of the Malaysia Co -operative
Societies Commission Act 2007 [Act 665], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Malaysia Co -operative Societies Commission
(Vesting Date) Order 2014.

Vesting date
2. The Minister appoints 1 January 2008  as the vesting date for the purpose s of
section 5 of the Act and on such date all properties, rights and liabilities of—

(a) the Government of Malaysia;

(b) the Registrar General of Co -operative Societies for Malaysia  under the
Co-operative Societies Act 1993 [Act 502];

(c) the Registrar of Fishermen's Associations under the Fishermen's
Associations Act 1971 [Act 44]; and

(d) the Registrar of  Farmers' Organizations under the Farmer s' Organization
Act 1973 [Act 109],

specified in the Schedul e shall be transferred to and be vested in the Malaysia
Co-operative Societies Commission without any conveyance, assignment or transfer.
